notes.title: Honor Cry: Aftermath - Price Reduction and New Game Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers,
Our RPG experience Honor Cry: Aftermath is getting a new lower price ($1.99 once it takes effect) and a new game patch to improve the game itself!

Changes:
- Increased Item Durability 15-30% so that items don't break so fast.
- Made the first few screens a bit easier in terms of enemies so you don't get ambushed by a vastly superior enemy right as you're starting out.
- Made random encounters about 5% less frequent.
- Streamlined combat so that if there's only 1 enemy, you don't have to click on their name every time.
- Made hit chances a bit higher, about 4%.
- Made the main quest in the second swamp area a bit easier by giving the player a hint where to find the Remove Curse scroll, and giving it to them possibly if they fail in the Gamemaster game 3 or more times.

Comments welcomed. Thanks and enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: New price and info about future!
notes.content:
Hello gamers,
I have revised the price of Catacombs 1: Demon War based on user feedback, as well as cemented future plans for the game.

The price has been revised to $2.99 permanently, based on the 3-5 hour length of the game and user interactions. This should help those on the fence about the game. The game has undergone lots of updates and changes based on player feedback since 1.0, and is now a fairly balanced and solid game. No one strategy will always work.

Also -- Catacombs 2: Hell's Wrath will be the follow-up to the game, and development has started. You'll be able to continue your character or start a new character, and will be around 3-5 hours in length as well. Release is tentatively scheduled for early 2018.

Thanks and enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: Version 1.04 released!
notes.content:
This 1.04 revision alters and tweaks some of the game based on player input. The goal was to make it slightly tougher than before.

- Changed the 'Rage Slash' attack so that it now costs 2 Mana and 2 Life points per use, instead of the previous 1 Mana and 1 Life. It was deemed to be too powerful.
- Tweaked the chances of finding healing potions after fights down about 15-20%.
- Tweaked the chances of finding overall items down by 5% after combats.
- Tweaked down the amounts of gold after fights by 5-10%.
- Changed the Diabolus spell so that it now costs 5 Mana and 4 Life to use and it now has a 60% chance to kill -- instead of costing 5 Mana and 2 Life, with a 70% chance to kill.
- Fixed 'of the Tundra' weapon suffix so that it now works properly.

Thanks and comments are always welcomed!
Derek

notes.title: Basic Game Info
notes.content:
Greetings Steam wanderer! Here's some basic info about the game for those that might be curious.

[b]How much will the game cost when it comes out?[/b]
The game is projected to be $4.99 with a 10% discount in the first week of release. 

[b]How long will it be?[/b]
The game will be (assuming all side quests are read and done) around 3-4 hours in length.

[b]I'm a streamer and wish to play the game on my channel.[/b]
I do welcome inquiries like this. Please email simprosestudios@gmail.com with the details of your Twitch/YouTube channel and I can possibly provide a free code for review purposes. Same goes for Curators on Steam.

[b]The 1 in the title means there will be future games?[/b]
It will be a 3-chapter trilogy set in the same universe with some shared characters that will complete the storyline.

Thanks and have fun!
Derek - CEO, SimProse Studios
